title: I CAN 2026 Summer Kickoff
location: Collins Park Recreation Center, Toledo OH
body:
Registration is open for the I CAN Program's 2026 summer session. Join us at Collins Park on May 17th for orientation day — meet your coaches, pick up your free gear, and find out what this summer has in store.

The I CAN Program is completely free for all participants ages 8–18. No experience necessary. Equipment provided. All you need to bring is yourself and a willingness to learn.

Parents are welcome to attend orientation. Light refreshments will be served. Space is limited to 75 youth, so sign up early via the contact page.
